newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka avg annual inflation 16.7 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka avg annual inflation 16.7 pct in March.

text.p: Sri Lanka's March inflation, based on a 12-month moving average, remained unchanged at 16.7 percent, compared with February, the Census and Statistics Department said on Monday.
The Colombo Consumers' Price Index (CCPI) for March fell 21.7 points or 1.1 percent to 2,009.6 from 2,031.3 in February, it said in a statement.
The CCPI dropped mainly because of falls in the prices of rice, sugar, dried chillies, red onions, coconuts, coconut oil, potatoes, and some varieties of vegetables and fish, it said.
But it said prices of coriander, cumin seed, limes, beef, mutton, eggs and some varieties of dried fish rose during the month.
